page.overview:
Who is Cherie?

Cherie is an older, female Flip-Flopian that is yellow in color.

Cherie lives in Flipside on the first floor. She loves her boyfriend very much despite not knowing his occupation. She is also a known singer and will sing to the heroes whenever she gets the chance.
